response:
from flask import Flask, request app = Flask(__name__) @app.route('/display') def display_message(): message = request.args.get('message', '') html = f"""

CTF Challenge - Message Display

Your message:

{message}
""" return html if __name__ == '__main__': app.run(debug=True)
